zoomPanel.withAZoomSelected.description: Zoom tab: the sentence after the no-selection hint. {levels} says what the level keys do ("1–4 set its zoom level, 0 pulls back").

zoomPanel.itWasIgnoredAutomatically.description: Zoom tab › Selected click: added after "Ignored: …" when the click was ignored automatically. {reason} says why. Starts with a space.

zoomPanel.madeForTheClick.description: Zoom tab › Selected zoom: an automatic zoom made for a click. {time} is when (1:02.5).

zoomPanel.changingTheseSettingsRegenerat.description: Zoom tab › Auto zoom: the summary. {found} says what input was found ("12 clicks · 2 typing detected.").

preset.pullBack.description: Zoom tab: tooltip of the 0.75× level chip, which zooms out.

zoomPanel.seconds.description: Zoom tab: a length in seconds, the value of a slider (0.70 s).

zoomPanel.selectAZoom.description: Zoom tab: hint when no zoom is selected.

zoomPanel.ignoreThisClickTitle.description: Zoom tab › Selected click: tooltip of Ignore click (its shortcut follows in brackets).

zoomPanel.cause.typing.description: Zoom tab › Selected zoom: an automatic zoom made for typing. {time} is when.

zoomPanel.span.description: Zoom tab › Selected zoom: its two times and its length in seconds.
